Name: The Arena
Author: thesandmansleeps
Description:
[b][center]*** READ THE CHANGELOGS ***[/center][/b]

This is my second "mod" (if you can call them that}. Made primarily for co-op with my wife. Relies heavily on SpaceCore.

This is a PIF mod that adds a room which is an arena. Inside there's a shop where you buy monster candy which summons a group of the respective monster for you to fight. It's great for practicing fighting, farming resources, and completing monster hunting goals (maybe too great).

How to access the arena:
PIF (required mod) adds a merchant to the bus tunnel that sells magic doors. 
Buy a door
place it
set it to the arena
go in

Here is how it works:
﻿You buy slime candy and 30 slimes are spawned [s]as soon as you buy it[/s] [b]when you eat it[/b]. 
[s]﻿The candy you bought will be in your inventory and you can eat it for a short buff of +1 speed & +50 magnetism.[/s]
﻿The price is 10 slime (or something that drops from the monster you are summoning}.
﻿You can buy as many as you want and it will summon as long as there is space to summon (top half-ish of the map).
*Caution: the shop buys many things to help deal with all the drops you'll get. My wife sold her sword :D. Be Careful.

Currently you can summon: slimes, grubs, flies, rock crabs, wilderness golems,  bats, dust spirits, ghosts, skeletons, void spirits, serpents, pepper rexs, lava lurks, magma sprites, and randomized challenge level.
There is also a Yoba shrine [s]which will bestow "Yoba's Blessing" (slow health regeneration)[/s] Buff is now applied while inside the arena (hp regen, speed, magnetism)

I'm very inexperienced with modding so feedback is welcome. Suggestions are run by my wife to determine if she thinks it would be enjoyable. She's not a gamer but loves stardew.
Thanks for checking it out. Have fun.
